title: ASTRIS
services: Logo · Color System · Typography · Brand Guidelines
shortDesc: A complete brand identity system for a deeptech aerospace company — precision-engineered visuals built to communicate authority and the inevitable convergence of technology.

sections.title: About the Brand
sections.body:
Astris operates at the frontier of deeptech and aerospace systems integration. The name evokes the stars — and the brand needed to match that gravity. The challenge was building a visual identity that felt as precise and inevitable as the technology itself.

No noise. No decoration for decoration's sake. Every element in the Astris brand serves the central idea: that convergence is inevitable — of technology, of purpose, of the future arriving whether you're ready or not.

sections.title: Logo & Variations
sections.body:
The Astris mark is built from nested geometric forms — a square outer frame, a rotated inner diamond, and converging corner lines that create the illusion of dimensional depth. It holds its precision from favicon to billboard.

The wordmark pairs the mark using a tight, monospace-inspired letterform to reinforce the engineering aesthetic.

sections.title: Color Palette
sections.body: Three primary colors form the visual backbone of Astris — chosen to give the brand an innovative feel and deeptech aerospace aesthetic. Haiti (deep navy), Electric Violet (lavender), and Blue Chalk (off-white) occupy a major section of every visual representation.

sections.title: Typography
sections.body: Morfa is the primary font — chosen for its sleek, modern monospace character. Used for headings and the brand wordmark. Space Grotesk serves as the secondary typeface for body texts and numeral representations.
